about_the_game:
“Cursed Memory” is a visual novel about adventure, dark fate, and terrifying trials that the characters must endure together.

Immerse yourself in a dark fantasy world inspired by medieval themes. “Cursed Memory” offers several layers of storytelling: on one hand, an adventure filled with darkness and drama; on the other, a mature story exploring questions such as whether you will be forgotten after death, and how to live when little time remains. The answers to these questions are for the player to discover throughout the game.

Features:
• Languages: English, Russian

The world of Mirein is rich with gods, races, and ancient conflicts. Elves, fauns, dwarves, humans, draconids, dragons, beasts, ledors, and demons inhabit this land.

You are a cursed adventurer. In an era of shifting borders and greedy rulers, any day could be your last. Since the First Sin War, when humans rebelled against the god of mankind, the cursed have become a reality — beings who lose their memories and slowly turn into demons.

Once transformed into demons, their past is erased from the memories of others. But the hero lives — as long as he remains alive. His journey is shared with Lina, a girl with draconid blood.

In addition to classic visual novel features, Cursed Memory offers turn-based combat, where you can build character setups by acquiring items throughout the story and face dangerous enemies using a variety of skills.For those seeking a greater challenge, there’s the "Trial" mode, where you can test your party management skills under increased difficulty.

name: Cursed Memory

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most standard home and office PCs. Video playback may require WebM codecs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 630 / AMD Radeon HD 6570 or better (OpenGL compatible)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smooth performance with additional plugins, animations, and higher-resolution assets.

short_description: Cursed Memory is a dark fantasy visual novel where the drama of fate intertwines with relentless trials. Engage in turn-based battles, test your skills in mini-games and trading, and most importantly — uncover the truth behind the curse that erases memories and turns people into demons.
